sources.entry: toga - A Python-native, OS-native GUI toolkit.

summary.one_liner: Toga is a Python-native GUI toolkit that renders with each operating system's native widgets.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Toga as a Python native, OS native GUI toolkit. It states that each backend has its own platform-specific requirements and prerequisites, which are covered in the platform documentation. A demo app is available by installing the toga-demo package and running the toga-demo command, which opens a window with sample widgets. Full documentation is hosted on Read The Docs. The README also points to the BeeWare community channels and a contribution guide for developers setting up a development environment.
use_cases: building desktop GUI applications in Python
trying out GUI widgets with a demo app
learning Python GUI development with BeeWare
notable: Python-native API that uses each operating system's native widgets
Part of the BeeWare suite of tools
Ships a demo app (toga-demo) to see sample widgets quickly
Documentation hosted on Read The Docs
caveats: Each backend has specific platform requirements and prerequisites that must be checked in the platform docs
The README does not name supported operating systems or list them directly
keywords: make a windows app in python
make a mac app in python
